records.title: Tari Proposal on All-IP Interconnection Between Telecom Networks
details:
(a): Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) is undertaking a comprehensive review of existing interconnection regulations to ensure that the regulatory framework takes into account evolution of technology and changes in the telecommunications sector.
e to g): Consultation paper on "Review of existing TRAI Regulations on Interconnection matters" has been released by TRAI on 10.11.2025. Comments on the issues raised in the consultation paper are invited from the stakeholders. Based on
the outcome of the ongoing consultation process with the stakeholders, suitable decisions on the matters related to Interconnection regulations will be taken by TRAI.

records.title: MASTER PLAN FOR DELHI-2041
details:
Part (c); The Ministry received 26 proposals from 21 States up to the last date. Due to non-receipt of qualitative proposals from North-Eastern States,
fresh/revised proposals were sought from these States. Consequently,
total 28 proposals from 23 States have been received. All the proposals
are at the competent level for examination/scrutiny.

records.title: DELAYS IN COMPLETION OF RAILWAY PROJECTS IN KANNIYAKUMARI AND VIRUDHUNAGAR
details: a to e: Final Location Survey (FLS) for doubling of Katpadi - Villupuram (160_Km), doubling of Salem - Karur - Dindigul (160 Km) and doubling of Erode - Karur (65 Km) have been sanctioned. The projects are still at planning stage and yet to be sanctioned.

records.title: GST Exemption on Insurance Premium for senior citizens
details:
a: the GST Council recommended to constitute a Group of Ministers (GoM) to holistically look into the issues pertaining to GST on life insurance and health insurance. Accordingly, a Group of Ministers (GoM) on Life and Health Insurance was constituted under the Chairmanship of Sh. Samrat Chaudhary, Hon'ble Deputy CM, Bihar. The GoM on life and Health Insurance has not yet submitted its report to the GST Council.
b: The Gom on Rate Rationalization has not yet submitted its report to the GST Council.
